svg.title: SKP-101W wheel metric comparison
svg.desc: Static orthographic projection of actual model triangles. Axle centers aligned. Nominal red circle is a software reference, not measured physical tire accuracy.

g.text: Wheel geometry / common scale and axle-center alignment
CPU SVG projection, not a browser screenshot. Red = nominal circumcircle. 0.60 px/mm. No 99% accuracy claim.
Tread lugs make rear X/Y spans differ even when the rotational tire body is round. Left wheels shown; right wheels share the same parameters.
